sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:26162
Court No. - 91
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1101 of 2020

Applicant :- Smt Saroj And 5 Ors
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jaysingh Yadav Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the proceeding against the applicants in Case Crime No. 1073 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 352, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station-Kotwali, District Lalitpur in Case No. 5395 of 2017 (State Vs. Manoj Singh)
pending in the court concerned.
3. It is submitted that the applicant no. 1 is bua of applicant no. 7.
Applicant no. 7 is the husband of opposite party no. 2.
It is submitted that the applicant no. 1 and her children were named in the F.I.R while they have no concern with the incident.
It is submitted that without any evidence charge sheet has been filed by the Investigating Officer.
Applicant no. 7, filed a petition for divorce but it was dismissed for non prosecution and appeal is pending.
Applicant no. 7 is also paying Smt Saroj And 5 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113558492/

entities.text: Smt Saroj And 5 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 maintenance to opposite party no. 2.
4.
Per contra, learned A.G.A assisted by learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 opposed the prayer made by the applicants and submitted that charge sheet came to be filed against the applicants.
Applicant no. 1 has performed the marriage of the applicant no. 7 since he was not having his mother.

Applicants made demand of dowry from opposite party no. 2.
5.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record,
the prayer for quashing proceeding against the applicants in Case Crime No. 1073 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 352, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station-Kotwali,District Lalitpur in Case No. 5395 of 2017 (State Vs. Manoj Singh) is refused.

6. However, it is provided that in case the applicants apply for bail within a period of 30 days from today, his application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
7.
